title: Bayer-Monsanto Merger Backlash Risk
reason: The transcript discusses a merger and its consequences.

tasks.task: Discuss the acquisition of Monsanto by Bayer.

subtasks.text: In 2018, Bayer acquired Monsanto for $63 billion, aiming to dominate the global agricultural market.
The deal faced global backlash due to Monsanto's controversial reputation linked to GMOs and glyphosate lawsuits.
Bayer inherited over 100,000 lawsuits related to Monsanto's weed killer Roundup, alleging it caused cancer.
Legal costs and reputational damage resulted in billions in losses and a sharp drop in Bayer's market value.

tasks.task: Highlight the cautionary tale of the merger.

subtasks.text: This merger became a cautionary tale that financial synergy can't erase public distrust.
